title: Ledger Coding Reference — Returned-Payment Reserve Kept from a Credit, Patient Financial Account
content:
**Entry: returned-payment reserve.** A reserve against returned payments is kept from a credit on the Patient Financial Account:

- for an account with at least the tier's number of returned payments before restriction — 2 on every financial class — of returned check or ACH payments in the 12 calendar months before the handling date, the tier's returned-payment fee multiplied by that number of returns is kept;
- for an account with exactly one such return, one returned-payment fee is kept;
- otherwise no returned-payment reserve is kept.

What is kept stays on the account as a credit and is not refunded.

**Returned-payment fee by class:** 0.00 on the Medicaid Managed Care Account; 30.00 on the Self-Pay, Medicare Part B, Medicare Advantage, Commercial HMO/EPO, Commercial PPO/POS and High-Deductible Health Plan accounts.

**Counting.** A return is a payment reversal of a check or ACH payment, dated by the reversal; card chargebacks are not counted. A window of calendar months for the credit refund ends on the handling date and reaches back that many months, a date on the same calendar day that many months earlier falling outside it.

| Check or ACH returns in the 12 months | Reserve kept, Commercial PPO/POS Account | Reserve kept, Medicaid Managed Care Account |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | nothing | nothing |
| 1 | 30.00 | 0.00 |
| 2 | 60.00 | 0.00 |
| 3 | 90.00 | 0.00 |
